episodes.166076: Steep low-level lapse rates combined with a passing polar cold front to produce several strong evening thunderstorms, whose downdrafts brought a few marginally severe wind gusts in and north of Indianapolis.
episodes.166095: A small line of thunderstorms spawned by an upper low produced brief storm-force winds over portions of the middle and lower tidal Potomac River, the tidal Patuxent River, and the middle portion of the Chesapeake Bay.
episodes.166540: Convective showers with isolated thunderstorms produced locally strong to severe wind gusts over Delmarva on March 26.
episodes.167899: Runoff after a rainfall event created some western Wisconsin river flooding in late March. Up to 1.5 inches of rain fell across the area and helped to cause flooding along the Black and Yellow Rivers.
episodes.167914: Scattered showers and thunderstorms in advance of a cold front produced gusty winds across portions of the Maryland Coastal Waters.
episodes.167915: Scattered showers and thunderstorms in advance of a cold front produced gusty winds across portions of the Virginia Coastal Waters.
episodes.168085: Storm force northwest wind gusts developed at Stannard Rock Light on the morning of the 26th in the wake of a strong cold front.

events.narrative: Runoff after a rainfall event pushed the Black River out of its banks near Galesville. The river crested almost a half foot above the flood stage at 12.44 feet on the 26th.
